purpose: FreeRTOS-native Waveshare 4.3 touch console with a fixed 768x480 landscape contract, Windows 3.1-style file/game/save/terminal tools, shared platform services, open game formats, bounded SD content discovery, multiplayer session primitives, and exclusive Doom and Quake easter-egg handoffs.

shell.surface: board-independent 768x480 OS landscape canvas; the launcher and p4-native-static-v1 games retain a scaled 320x200 compatibility surface
shell.input: bounded GT911 polling with up to five contacts

desktop_services.file_manager: bounded SD catalog with name/type/size sorting; read-only on the current hardware authorization
desktop_services.save_manager: bounded per-game slot catalog; atomic write/import/export activation remains gated
desktop_services.terminal: bounded command prompt with touch keyboard and a sanitized physical-key entry point
desktop_services.ssh: terminal UX and OS transport boundary implemented; Wi-Fi/TCP/crypto transport not yet qualified
desktop_services.usb_export: UI and action boundary implemented but disabled; current H1 protocol accepts only the exact Quake shareware PAK

native_game_api.code_model: RISC-V machine code statically linked into the Console OS ELF
native_game_api.uf2_note: UF2 is a flashing container, not the executable format used by this ESP-IDF project.
native_game_api.audio: optional bounded tone and copied PCM-stream services at PCM16 stereo 16000 Hz
native_game_api.registry: all enabled games/*/game.json manifests discovered at configure time
native_game_api.hardware_access: forbidden; games use only the p4_game_api services

usb_copy.physical_port: H1 programming USB-C through CH343 USB-UART
usb_copy.current_target: exact Quake v1.06 shareware PAK only

quake_handoff.surface: 512x300 engine scaled to 768x450 inside the 768x480 OS canvas
quake_handoff.audio: software-mixed PCM through the OS-owned 16000 Hz stereo session

next_hardware_step: After build verification, bind and authorize the exact new console artifact before any guarded flash and record separate on-device acceptance evidence.
